# MesoViewSpec: reference, built-in resolvers

The resolvers the runtime has by default; a host adds its own to the list. What a resolver is for, and the contract, is
in [runtime.md](../runtime.md). The version is bumped when the same input gives a different result.

| Id                 | Version | Arrangements                 | Locations                                                            | Formats                               | Honours          | Meaning                                                                                                              |
| ------------------ | ------- | ---------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------- | ---------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `meso.pack`        | 0.1.1   | `random`                     | `interior`, `membrane`, `outer-surface`, `inner-surface`, `exterior` |                                       |                  | Seeded random sequential addition of spheres: interiors, membranes, surfaces, the space around                       |
| `meso.lattice`     | 0.2.2   | `lattice`                    | `membrane`, `outer-surface`, `inner-surface`                         |                                       |                  | Lattices on spherical and ellipsoidal membranes: Fibonacci sites at the lattice density, patches by count            |
| `meso.fiber`       | 0.3.2   | `fiber`, `random`            | `interior`                                                           |                                       | `binds`, `bends` | Filaments along a given path or grown as a persistent random walk; binders and benders placed on them by their sites |
| `meso.bilayer`     | 0.1.1   | `bilayer`                    | `membrane`                                                           |                                       |                  | Lipid bilayers on curved membranes: both leaflets at a density, heads outward                                        |
| `meso.precomputed` | 0.3.0   | `random`, `lattice`, `fiber` | `interior`, `membrane`, `outer-surface`, `inner-surface`, `exterior` | `relion-star`, `meso-placements+json` |                  | Placements from a file (RELION STAR particle lists, MesoViewSpec placement JSON) or the document's instances         |
| `meso.relax`       | 0.1.2   | `random`                     | `interior`, `membrane`, `outer-surface`, `inner-surface`, `exterior` |                                       |                  | Refines another model's placement: inserts missing copies, relaxes overlaps, keeps copies in their compartments      |
| `cellpack-gpu`     | 0.1.1   | `random`                     | `interior`, `membrane`, `outer-surface`, `inner-surface`, `exterior` | `cellpack-gpu-serialized`             |                  | cellPACKgpu serialized recipes: the recipe's principal vectors and membrane offsets on the shared packer             |
